prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, three-quarter-length demi statue portrait, 3-band horizontal multi-material body, no bare skin below the collarbones. ONE woman, angled 45 degrees toward the camera, framed so her whole sculpted form is visible from the top of her head down to two individually finished thigh tips right at the knee, where the leg would bend, her face in natural scale with her body — never an oversized close-up crop of just the face. Where her form comes to an end, it is because the sculpture itself ends there, not because a camera frame happens to cut her off.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Japanese woman in manba makeup — a deep bronze tan foundation over real skin, thick white paint bands above and below both eyes lying on the lids and never across the eyeballs, silver glitter lines across the lids, heavy black liner, very long false lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy white lips, small rhinestone stickers on the cheeks only, long bleached platinum hair with a neon streak, a fierce, playful expression. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real face, not an illustration, not a render, not cel-shaded. On each ear a thick black-steel hoop and a neon acrylic stud.

Physique: Her waist cinched to an impossible minimum, making the contrast with the enormous rear utterly extreme: the rear and hips flare to more than four times the width of that narrow waist, an enormous rounded rear projecting far out behind her and merging into the lower back and thighs as one continuous mass, a moderate chest, slim shoulders, left arm crystal, right arm stone, torso/hip/thigh-stubs in 3 stepped horizontal bands.

Boundary: a single straight, flat line runs around the base of the neck and across both collarbones, never jagged, never zigzag — real skin above, material immediately below, no skin anywhere lower. At that line, the material's edge rises in a small raised step, casting a crisp shadow.

Left arm (shoulder to hand): solid transparent deep ruby-red cast glass, never hollow. Right arm (shoulder to hand): carved solid deep royal-blue lapis lazuli with golden pyrite flecks, completely opaque, completely opaque.

Torso, hips and both thigh-stubs (excluding arms): 3 equal horizontal bands, stacked top to bottom, each with a raised stepped edge and shadow at its border, no gaps, no skin. Band 1 (torso/hip band 1): clear ice-blue water with drifting snowflakes. Band 2 (torso/hip band 2): clear coral-pink water with drifting light. Band 3 (both thigh-stubs, right at the knee, where the leg would bend): clear periwinkle-blue water with drifting feathers, sealing shut at both tips.

Setting: a huge backdrop behind her washed with two coloured lights from behind — a deep charcoal on one side and a bright gold on the other, blending into a smooth gradient in the middle, and a glossy dark floor beneath her.

Pose: standing tall, her left hand (crystal) resting on her flared hip, her right arm (stone) held clear of her body, the hand relaxed at hip height, both hands well away from her face, head tilted slightly toward the camera.

Lighting: two large softboxes rake across her body from either side, so charcoal light glances off one side and gold light glances off the other, catching a crisp glint along every stepped seam. A soft frontal light falls on her face and ears only. shot on a Hasselblad X2D with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
